title: LLM Alignment for the Arabs: A Homogenous Culture or Diverse Ones?
findings: Current Arabic-centric benchmarks, such as the Arabic Cultural Value Alignment (ACVA) benchmark, misrepresent the religious diversity of the Arab world. They often contain oversimplified and homogenizing statements, such as assuming all Arabs are Muslims and that Islam is an integral part of their cultural identity, thereby ignoring the presence and views of religious minorities like Christians and Jews, as well as secular individuals.
